title: 성공 feedback의 완료 전 예비 깨우기 축소
existingWork: 성공 feedback에서도 retireIfReady 전 notifyGroupWaiters가 호출됨.
missingEvidence: 과거 종료 문제 인근의 동시성 경로. 실제 불필요 wake와 비용 미확정.
requiredBoundary: error/poison/final-retirement notify와 실제 sleeping child/queue waiter 종료를 유지.

risk.function: 높음: error/poison/완료 wake 누락은 종료/대기를 영구 지연할 수 있음.
risk.lifetime: 높음: success state/retirement와 semantic signal owner 해제 조건 유지.
risk.synchronization: 높음: 이미 잠든 waiter, missing terminal feedback, error-success race, inline/duplicate/range/tail callback.
risk.memory: 새 저장소는 불필요하지만 hang은 in-flight 자원 장기보유 가능.

strategy: Suppress only success feedback pre-retirement notification. Actual child predicate is Completed||error; queue predicate is pending0||firstError. Success feedback bits alone satisfy neither. feedback.error preserves the early notification even with zero handlers; final/error/poison notifications remain.
acceptance: CPU sleeping-waiter schedules pass; validate actual native callback progress after activation
Every terminal/error path and inline/duplicate/range/tail callback reaches a preserved notification
Existing shutdown failures remain visible; this is not a shutdown fix without reproduction
tests: Existing backend timeline/completion/recording-ownership CPU tests with deterministic sleeper-before-notify schedules
Error-success race, missing terminal feedback and delayed completion; bounded timeout is test failure
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
